import pikepdf

pdf = pikepdf.open('/root/sc100-blank.pdf')

def find_all_fields(fields, prefix=""):
    result = {}
    for field in fields:
        obj = field if isinstance(field, pikepdf.Dictionary) else pdf.get_object(field)
        name = str(obj.get('/T', '')) if '/T' in obj else ''
        full = prefix + '.' + name if prefix else name
        kids = obj.get('/Kids', None)
        if kids:
            result[full] = obj
            result.update(find_all_fields(kids, full))
        else:
            result[full] = obj
    return result

    if field_path in all_fields:

        obj[pikepdf.Name('/V')] = pikepdf.String(value)
        print(f"SET TEXT: {field_path} = {value}")
    else:

    """Set a standalone checkbox to checked."""
    if field_path in all_fields:
        obj = all_fields[field_path]
        obj[pikepdf.Name('/V')] = pikepdf.Name(on_state)
        obj[pikepdf.Name('/AS')] = pikepdf.Name(on_state)
        print(f"SET CHECKBOX: {field_path} = {on_state}")
    else:
        print(f"NOT FOUND: {field_path}")

    """Set a radio button group. selected_state is like '/1' or '/2'."""
    if parent_path in all_fields:
        parent = all_fields[parent_path]
        parent[pikepdf.Name('/V')] = pikepdf.Name(selected_state)
        kids = parent.get('/Kids', [])
        for kid in kids:
            kid_obj = kid if isinstance(kid, pikepdf.Dictionary) else pdf.get_object(kid)
            ap = kid_obj.get('/AP', {})
            normal = ap.get('/N', {})
            if isinstance(normal, pikepdf.Dictionary):

                if selected_state in states:
